init_hook: export PROJECT_ROOT="${DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT:-$(d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/devbox.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/devbox.json" ]; then echo "$d"; else echo "$PWD"; fi)}"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/.env.example" ]; then cp "$PROJECT_ROOT/.env.example" "$ENV_FILE" && echo "[devbox] created $ENV_FILE from .env.example"; fi

if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] && ! grep -q '^ENCRYPTION_KEY=.\{32\}$' "$ENV_FILE"; then KEY=$(head -c 24 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d '\n=+/' | head -c 32); KEY=$(printf '%-32s' "$KEY" | tr ' ' 'x'); if grep -q '^ENCRYPTION_KEY=' "$ENV_FILE"; then sed "s|^ENCRYPTION_KEY=.*|ENCRYPTION_KEY=$KEY|" "$ENV_FILE" > "$ENV_FILE.tmp" && mv "$ENV_FILE.tmp" "$ENV_FILE"; else echo "ENCRYPTION_KEY=$KEY" >> "$ENV_FILE"; fi; echo '[devbox] generated a 32-char ENCRYPTION_KEY'; fi
if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] && grep -q '^DATABASE_URL=' "$ENV_FILE"; then sed "s|^DATABASE_URL=.*|DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL|" "$ENV_FILE" > "$ENV_FILE.tmp" && mv "$ENV_FILE.tmp" "$ENV_FILE"; fi
if [ "$PROJECT_ROOT" != "$PWD" ]; then echo "  cwd : $PWD   (scripts still run against root)"; fi
echo '  devbox run setup          first time: install, init db, migrate, seed'
echo '  devbox services up        start postgres + redis (leave running)'
echo '  devbox run dev            next dev on :3000'
echo '  devbox run stripe:listen  main webhook    -> /api/stripe/webhook'
echo '  devbox run stripe:connect connect events  -> /api/stripe/connect-webhook'
echo '  devbox run where          show every resolved path'
echo '  devbox run check          typecheck + lint'

setup: echo '--> initialising postgres cluster (skipped if it exists)'
echo '--> creating database (skipped if it exists)'
createdb agentvault 2>/dev/null || echo '    agentvault already exists'
echo '--> done. demo API keys are printed above.'
stripe:status: echo '--- STRIPE_* keys present in .env (values hidden) ---'
